posts.post:
the absolute worst feeling is wearing a new piece that feels 'too precious' to move in.

if you can't live in it, it’s not clothing.

everyone obsesses over the fit of their shirt.

but if your socks aren't sitting right, the whole look is off.

it took us four months to realize the side seams were creating a slight tension point.

fixed it. you’d never notice, but i do.
